newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish 1997 CPI seen at 16.8 pct - banking survey.
newsitem.headline: Polish 1997 CPI seen at 16.8 pct - banking survey.

text.p: Polish bankers expected year-on-year inflation to fall to 16.8 percent in December 1997 from 18.1 percent in January, a monthly poll released on Tuesday by the private Pentor intitute showed.
Last month Pentor's poll, conducted among over 200 bank managers, showed inflation at 16.7 percent at the end of 1997.
A Reuter poll done earlier this week showed year-end inflation at 16.27 percent.
Pentor's poll showed that the zloty was expected to fall at end-1997 to 3.36 to the U.S. dollar. The zloty stood at 3.0860 to the dollar at Tuesday's close.
According to the Reuter poll the zloty was seen at 3.4057 to the dollar by the end of the year.
